reviews.title: Awesome Game. Awesome Devs. Awesome Support.
reviews.text: I really enjoy this game and play it daily. They constantly add new heroes and features. Winning doesn't require spending money, but if you choose to, you can buy exactly what you need—no need to purchase unnecessary items. Their support team is very helpful and responds quickly. They promptly resolve any game problems, often apologize, and sometimes give compensation for any inconvenience.

reviews.title: Money grab
reviews.text:
It’s a fun game that you can easily play for free, but it is clear that you will have to spend money to get the food characters.  There are gems you can earn to spend in events like “Lucky Draw”, but no one in my guild got the prized character to unlock.  

Also, on the events where you spin a wheel to try and get characters or the best prizes, no one has one the characters by playing free.  The worst part is when you free spin and the wheel lands on the exact same basic prize several times in a row.   

The game is obviously rigged against free players, so be warned.

reviews.title: Difficulty
reviews.text: Genuinely this game is fun, I just think some levels are super hard for absolutely no reason. For example, I am on chapter 37 with a level 47 Knight, why do the sky knights do so much damage and feel so strong for an enemy that is actually weaker than the earth giants. Another complaint I have is that every time I try to get assistance with the game via tutorial everyone either already has pets and can farm hard mode after beating chapter 30 but I haven’t unlocked anything.

reviews.title: False Advertisement!
reviews.text:
I’ve played this game before but when recently getting an Ad for it, when looking at the download page it showed false gameplay images. An easy manual search in the App Store (word for word) showed what the game actually plays like. Massively disappointing.

I’ve noticed this with other games which is unfortunate as I did enjoy my time with this game! I recommend not supporting the game or developers in anyway.
